title: Shared definitions
description: Shapes every husk document kind uses: identity, links to data, byte ranges, the contract header's parts, vectors and curves.

identity.description: What the thing structurally is. The kind says which identity space the value belongs to; values from different kinds never compare equal.

oneOf.description: A file identified by its numeric file id.
A row of a named data table.
A position in a list the surrounding document defines.

ref.description: A reference: structural identity plus a display name whose origin is stated. The name is decoration and may be wrong; the identity is what to compare.

name.description: Display name; empty when there is none.

name_source.description: Where the name came from: embedded in the source file, a community file list, a data table, made up by the exporter, or absent.

asset_ref.description: A reference to another document, with a uri when that document was exported alongside. Without a uri the reference is known but unresolved.

name.description: Display name; empty when there is none.

uri.description: Path of the referenced document's manifest or file, relative to this document.

payload.description: Data stored in its own file. The media type tells a consumer how to read it; the format does not restrict which types are allowed.

uri.description: Path of the file, relative to this document.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the file's contents.

buffer_slice.description: A typed array stored as raw little-endian bytes in a binary file next to the document. byte_length is always count * component_count * the component's size.

file.description: Binary file, relative to this document.

byte_offset.description: Start of the array in the file.

byte_length.description: Length of the array in bytes.

semantic.description: Well-known vertex attribute name, where the array is one.

flags.description: A bit field as stored by the source, in lowercase hex.

quat.description: Rotation quaternion x, y, z, w.

rgb.description: Colour r, g, b in 0..1 as stored, no gamma conversion.

rgba.description: Colour r, g, b, a in 0..1 as stored, no gamma conversion.

space.description: The frame every position, direction and angle in the document is expressed in.

provenance.description: Who wrote the document, when, from what input, and which data sources could be consulted.

input_format.description: Name of the input format the document was decoded from; informational.

sources.description: Every data source the exporter could have asked, and whether it could. An absent value whose source was available means the subject has none; one whose source was unavailable is unknown.

name.description: What the source is, e.g. a table name or the file list.

role.description: What the exporter uses it for.

detail.description: Why it was unavailable, or where it was read from.

reference.description: Another document this one depends on.

asset.description: Identity, and uri when exported alongside.

document.description: The referenced document itself, written inline instead of as its own file; checked like a file of its kind.

source_record.description: Which source record an entry was decoded from.

table.description: Name of the source table or chunk.

index.description: Position of the record in that table.

sequence_kind.description: Whether a curve plays during an animation sequence or loops on a global timer.

interpolation.description: How values between keyframes are computed.

inline_curve.description: Keyframes for one sequence or global sequence.

keyframes.description: [time, value] pairs; the value is a number or an array, depending on the property.

animated.description: A property's curves, one per sequence that animates it; [] means never animated and no value.

lifetime_curve.description: Keyframes over a particle's own age: [raw timestamp 0..32767 read as a fraction of the lifespan, value].

texture_entry.description: A texture reference and whether it could be resolved.

state.description: Resolved; known but not found; or several plausible candidates.

identity.description: Identity of the texture: the resolved one, or the one that was looked for.

payload.description: The texture's data, when it was exported.

unresolved_reason.description: Why a known texture was not found.

candidates.description: Plausible textures when the reference is ambiguous.

liquid_type.description: A liquid type a document's liquids name. Without the liquid DB2s only its identity is known.

identity.description: The LiquidType row, named from its Name; each liquid's liquid_type equals one entry's identity.

vertex_format.description: The vertex layout the material states (0 height+depth, 1 height+uv, 2 depth, 3 height+uv+depth). Ocean (LiquidType 2) instances store depth only whatever this says; a liquid's own arrays are what it holds.

textures.description: The type's texture slots, in LiquidType order. Which slot a shader samples for what depends on the material and is not resolved.

frames.description: The slot's frames in animation order; one frame for a still texture.

kind.description: LiquidTypeXTexture.Type as stored: -1 a file, 0 to 2 a texture the client generates (no file).

instance_ref.description: One instance of an owned placement set, by its stable id rather than its position.

id.description: The instance's id in that set.

input_kind.description: The shape of an effect input's value. The kind says what the value is, never how a consumer stores it.

input_spec.description: One input an effect declares: its kind, and what an instance must supply for it.

description.description: What the input means to the effect.

unit.description: Unit of a number or vector value.

options.description: The values a choice may take.

clock.description: What a curve is keyed by: time within an animation, normalized particle age, or time of day.

optional.description: An instance may leave the input out; absent means not stated.

default.description: The value an instance that leaves the input out gets.

binding.description: A field whose value comes from the instance: an input by name, or a field of the element a for_each source repeats over.

oneOf.description: A field of the current for_each element.

each.description: Field name in the element record.

bound_number.description: A number, or a binding to one.

bound_integer.description: An integer, or a binding to one.

bound_image.description: An image, or a binding to one.

bound_mesh.description: A model, or a binding to one.

tree_box.description: One box of a box tree.

children.description: The boxes it splits into, by index in the tree; none for a leaf.

complete.description: True: the children partition it. False: they may share leaves, so it is a union of overlapping pieces.

bound_vec3.description: Three numbers, or a binding to them.

region.description: Where an effect source applies, relative to its instance. Every region may fade over a soft edge.

oneOf.description: Everywhere the instance's anchor reaches: the whole model, or the whole map.
A point: where the source is, its extent stated by its content or style.
A sphere: full strength inside inner_radius, fading out to outer_radius.

outer_radius.description: Radius where it has faded out.

edge.description: Width of a soft fade beyond the radii; absent: none stated.

oneOf.description: An axis-aligned box in the instance's frame.

edge.description: Width of the fade in from the faces; absent: none stated.

oneOf.description: The inside of a model's mesh, in the instance's frame.

model.description: The model whose mesh bounds the region.

oneOf.description: A box refined by a tree of boxes inside it: the root (the box no other lists as a child) is the whole, the leaves its pieces.

boxes.description: The tree's boxes, or a binding to them.

oneOf.description: A convex volume: inside where dot(normal, p) <= distance holds for every plane.

planes.description: The bounding planes, or a binding to them.

edge.description: Width of the fade in from the faces; absent: none stated.

plane.description: A plane with an outward unit normal.

distance.description: Signed distance of the plane from the origin along its normal.

effect_source.description: One part of an effect: where it applies and what it puts in the world.

id.description: Unique within the effect; an instance's style is keyed by it.

parent.description: Id of the source this one lives in or spawns from.

for_each.description: A list input: the source repeats once per element, and each-bindings read the element.

region.description: Where it applies; absent: the parent's region, or everywhere for a source without one.

content.description: What it puts in the world; absent: nothing beyond its style.

effect_content.description: What an effect source puts in the world.

oneOf.description: A participating medium: what light passing through it loses and scatters.

extinction.description: Fraction of light lost per unit length.

albedo.description: Share of the lost light scattered rather than absorbed, linear RGB.

hold.description: How a simulation treats the stated values: pinned exactly, relaxed back toward as a base, or only started from as a seed.

spawn.description: How many particles the source holds; absent: not stated.

density.description: Particles per unit volume of the region.

light.description: How a particle meets light; absent: not stated.

role.description: Emission: it adds its colour as light. Albedo: it reflects the light reaching it.

oneOf.description: A camera-facing textured quad, its texture an atlas of animation frames.

frames.description: Frames the animation plays, from the first tile; may be fewer than the tiles.

extra_layers.description: Further textures layered over the first, in order; absent: one layer.

oneOf.description: A ribbon: a strip trailing behind the source, textured along its length.

extra_layers.description: Further textures layered over the first, in order; absent: one layer.

oneOf.description: A model drawn at each particle, oriented by the particle; it doesn't collide.

linear_fog.description: Fog that thickens linearly with distance from the viewer.

distance_fog.description: The classic client's fog over view distance, in the blocks a source states; an absent block inherits from the enclosing fog.

style_block.description: How the classic client drew one effect source.

distance_fog.description: Fog over view distance inside the source's region.

exit_blend.description: Draws nothing; scales the enclosing fog down near the model's exits.

looks.description: Alternative looks the client switched to under a viewer condition.

underwater.description: The fog while the viewer is under water.

ambient_color.description: The ambient colour the source overrides inside its region.

colors.description: The source's three colours in order; which one the client uses is unverified.

volumetric_fog.description: The classic client's volumetric fog pass inside the source's region.

min_quality.description: Drawn when the viewer's fog quality setting is at least this, 0..2.

particulate.description: The classic ambient particle system's own settings.

max_particles.description: Most particles the client simulates at once.

draw.description: How the classic client drew the source's particles.

blend.description: How a particle combines with what is already drawn.

particle_system.description: The classic particle system an M2 emitter ran.

ribbon_system.description: The classic ribbon an M2 emitter drew.

zone_fog.description: The classic zone light's fog, by the condition the client picks it under (wowdev.wiki DB/Light).

style.description: The classic look of an effect instance, by the effect's source id; a source repeated per list element has one look per element.

unresolved_field.description: A source value carried before its meaning is known.

field.description: Which source field, in the source's own terms.

kind.description: What class of value it is, as far as the data shows; words are a byte range's raw dwords.

value.description: The value as stored: a number, an array of numbers, a hex string for bits, or an array of hex strings for words.

candidate_role.description: A proposed typed field for the value, not yet confirmed.

unresolved.description: Source values whose meaning is not known yet; a consumer never needs them to draw.

ribbon_system.description: The classic ribbon simulation's settings and curves.

texture_transform_lookup_index.description: Unresolved index into the source's texture transform lookup.

particle_system.description: The classic particle simulation's settings and curves.

child_emitters_model.description: Model whose emitters each particle carries.

multi_texture_scale.description: Scale of the extra texture layers.

color.description: Colour over the particle's life, [r, g, b] as stored (0..255 observed).

multi_texture_scroll_mid.description: Scroll midpoints of the extra layers.

multi_texture_scroll_range.description: Scroll ranges of the extra layers.

priority.description: What a renderer thins first within its budget: decorative, then ambient; essential stays.

provenance_fields.description: How an instance's values were obtained, by path within the instance ("inputs.extinction", "priority"). A path not listed was read from the source.

kind.description: Computed by husk by a named rule, or written by a person.

rule.description: The derivation rule's name (REFACTOR/EFFECTS.md); a consumer can ignore everything one rule produced.

fog_cycle.description: A zone light's fog values at times of day, ascending; between two keys the client interpolates. Names follow the source table (LightData); their roles in the fog record are candidates (REFACTOR/EFFECTS.md).

items.description: The values at one time of day.

time.description: Time of day the values hold at.

sun_angle.description: Cosine past which sun fog starts (SunFogAngle).

height_coefficients.description: FogHeightCoefficients. Cubic coefficients x^3, x^2, x, 1.

main_coefficients.description: MainFogCoefficients. Cubic coefficients x^3, x^2, x, 1.

height_density_coefficients.description: HeightDensityFogCoeff. Cubic coefficients x^3, x^2, x, 1.
